release_notes: Right-click any sale (part or device) in the Sell History and choose **"Not a sale — remove from history"** — for cases the automatic cleanup can't know about, like an accidental sale stocked back in on a later day. The entry disappears from the daily record, the totals and the PDF report. Changed your mind? The right-click menu also offers **"Restore removed sales"** to bring every override back. As always, the Transactions page keeps the full raw movement history.
